correctness.rationale: Directly derived necessary residue-class invariant under both letters, explicit conjugate idempotent contractions and a deletion ordering on disjoint directed path chains. Minimal b count follows from rank dropping at most once per b. Count is exact multinomial linear extensions. Full power-subset BFS confirmed images for n=2..12, 77 (n,d) combinations; independent recursive deletion count verified 6496 cases for n<=9; proof remains symbolic for all parameters.

value.rationale: Determines exactly the entire subset-image spectrum, rank enumerator, least achievable rank, and target-dependent optimal contraction macro multiplicity of a natural infinite family of strongly connected nonsynchronizing automata. The precise noncoprime phase is the structural boundary excluded by the classical coprime complete-reachability theorem; results are not arbitrary finite cutoffs.
